B.table_comment: Immutable exact-run regional Marketing evidence. Freezes source-row identity, SKU/product/godown/region identity, signed actual units, signed billed units, signed tax-exclusive billed value, eligibility and source cutoff for each refresh run.

Immutable exact-run SKU × Region Marketing monetary allocation. One company Marketing pool is divided by resolved Product × Region signed billed sales value, then converted to regional per-SKU cost using the governed SKU × Region physical basis.

Immutable exact-run SKU × Region physical basis for regional Marketing allocation. Positive regional actual units have priority, followed by one governed regional assumption and then a region-scaled governed common SKU basis. Unresolved contexts remain blocked.
Immutable run-scoped allocation-basis snapshot. Historical annual evidence is retained separately from the canonical resolved monthly allocation driver used by downstream costing writers.

CI-037: per SKU and region (IK/OK) commercial profit chain, filled by fn_ci037_fill_pricing_bridge_profit inside the refresh chain. Estimated profit = scheme-adjusted selling price - contingency allowance - regional marketing - internal loaded cost, per delivered unit. Contingency is an allowance, not an incurred cost.

Immutable exact-run action queue for blocked SKU × Region Marketing allocation contexts. Each row identifies the governed Pricing Policy Manager action required before a later refresh can resolve regional Marketing cost.
Immutable exact-run monthly pool snapshot shared by Production Overhead, Quality Control Overhead and Materials/Stores Overhead.
Non-activating audited classification of reference source amounts. Does not itself approve normal budgets or capacity and must not substitute for manufacturing_standard_rate_policy.

CI-040 v2.1: approval preview acknowledgements (D2): evidence that the preview was generated/opened for this user, run and state (not that it was reviewed or understood). Append-only except marking an acknowledgement used once. Not auto-deleted; CI-043 reports accumulation.
